preparation_observations.findings: Non-test observe_operation expands to a block, so service result closures are required to retain observations on every ? return. Formatted diagnostic output uses one write call, including on Interrupted. Both fixed before the sole capsule attempt.

preparation_observations.finding: The original .log export matched repository ignore rules; the same exact control bytes are retained as observer-controls.txt so source publication includes them.

The new collector initially accepted complete JSON without its final LF. It now accepts only LF-terminated records and retains missing-LF and exact-4-KiB-cutoff negative cases plus an in-prefix LF positive case. This parser revision was formatted but its Rust controls remain pending new-source CI.

limitations: Diagnostic wall and thread CPU observations are not authenticated physical time or whole-host CPU.
A single bounded stderr write does not establish a wall-time bound for arbitrary blocked stderr; the unchanged CLI supervisor timeout still governs.
Observation clocks and stderr lock/write are diagnostic costs; success never changes a refusal or renews an original deadline.
The original 4 KiB stderr prefix is unchanged; an absent or incomplete record is unknown, never a successful result.
No original experiment, native pressure gate, original 250 ms witness exchange or four-second confirmation requirement is certified by these module controls.
